summary.text: Tim Reeder, listed by Ballotpedia as Timothy Reeder, is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 9 since January 1, 2023, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an emergency physician and educator.

paragraphs.text: Reeder was born in Columbus, Ohio, and earned a bachelor's degree in 1991 and an M.D. in 1995, both from Ohio State University.

In the 2022 survey, he said he moved to North Carolina in 1998 to join the Brody School of Medicine at East Carolina University, earned a master's degree in public health from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, held leadership roles at East Carolina University and Vidant Medical Center, and served as president of the North Carolina Medical Society in 2019.

For the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists Reeder as a member of the Appropriations, Appropriations on Health and Human Services, Commerce, Education - Universities, Families, Children, and Aging Policy, and Health committees.

In his 2022 survey, he listed education, the economy and solving problems as his key campaign messages, said he supports charter schools and parental choice, and said free-market solutions should be used instead of government solutions where possible.
